# GSAP 3.15.0

Unmodified browser distributions of GSAP core and ScrollTrigger, served locally so the site needs no third-party CDN requests.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.0.tgz

Copyright 2026, GreenSock. All rights reserved. Distributed under the [GSAP Standard License](https://gsap.com/standard-license/). Original license headers are retained in both files.

To update, download a pinned GSAP npm release and replace both files from its `dist` directory together. Test normal motion, reduced motion, missing-library fallback, and gesture interactions before publishing.
